card.name: Start of warning-section headings
card.fires_on: The first piece of a word right after a numbered warning heading or a list bullet, such as Bl in Blurred, normal in Abnormal, or complete in Incomplete. It fires on the early part of a split word in a label heading.

modes.label: Blurred vision heading
modes.description: The Bl piece of Blurred right after Drowsiness and/or or a bullet.

modes.label: Abnormal or incomplete heading
modes.description: The normal or complete piece after Ab or In in a numbered warning heading.

modes.label: Other split heading words
modes.description: A first piece of a split word at the start of a new item, such as Ch of Cholestyramine.

card.plain: It marks the middle of a split word in a warning heading, like Blurred Vision or Abnormal Bleeding.
